newsitem.title: DUBAI: Dubai air cargo traffic fell 2.6 pct in February.
newsitem.headline: Dubai air cargo traffic fell 2.6 pct in February.

text.p: Dubai airport cargo volumes fell 2.64 percent in February to 28,165 tonnes from 28,928 tonnes in the same month last year, Dubai Cargo Village figures show.
Exports fell by more than seven percent to 12,765 tonnes from 13,765 tonnes, while import tonnages edged up 1.56 percent to 15,400.
Transhipments moved up 2.58 percent to 4,618 tonnes.
Last year the airport handled a total of 358,982 tonnes.
Dubai is the second largest emirate and commercial centre of the seven members of the United Arab Emirates.
